semiconductor_relevance: High — AOI Electronics specializes in semiconductor back-end processes and advanced packaging technologies, making it a key player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: AOI Electronics Co., Ltd. is an independent manufacturer focused on semiconductor back-end processes, particularly in advanced packaging solutions. The company leverages its FOLP technology to provide high-quality products suitable for various applications, including automotive and AI power modules.
capabilities: Chiplet integration with Pillar Suspended Bridge (PSB)
Custom packaging solutions for high-frequency applications
Power module packaging using chip embedded technology
